title: Why Foreign Investors Are Seeing Opportunity in Japan
content: After decades of deflation and stagnation, Japan is embracing reform. With households and corporations sitting on trillions in cash, inflation has forced a shift in mindset. We examine whether the renaissance of Japan’s capital markets can power a long-awaited economic revival. (Source: Bloomberg)
